ideas.title: The Minnesota Fraud Scandal: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the Minnesota fraud scandal, including the personal care assistant accused of billing Medicaid $116K for services not provided.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
How did the fraud go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota fraud scandal suggests a larger issue with fraud in the state, and a deeper investigation is needed to uncover the full extent of the problem.

ideas.title: The Rise of Childcare Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: An investigation into the growing concern of childcare fraud, including cases in Ohio and other states.
questions: What is the prevalence of childcare fraud?
ideas.insight: The rise of childcare fraud suggests a need for greater oversight and regulation in the childcare industry.
